title: Five-person establishment and future roster periods
summary: Five permanent nurses from 12 October, with one-night Pager rotation and configurable future team periods.
changes: From 12 October 2026 the permanent roster has two First Part nurses, two Second Part nurses and one full-night Pager, starting with André Bartolo.
Pager advances once on each four-day roster night; all nights through 8 October remain unchanged.
Yentl leaves future permanent rostering while historical records and account access remain separate.
Administrators can preview and schedule future five- or six-person periods, joins, leaves and starting positions in Roster Management.
Absences, overtime, Labour Ward sharing and breaks follow the effective establishment, while five remains the minimum safe staffing threshold.
The tutorial explains normal five-person nights and future roster periods; older clients must update before editing the shared roster.
